description: Choose who your emails come from. Emails from our warmed-up Deeplead Inboxes go out under this name or from our sender profiles. Nothing sends from them until this is chosen. Ask the customer; never pick for them.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

name.description: With sendsAsPersonas false: the name to send as, usually the customer’s own, e.g. "Jane Doe". At most 200 characters.

sendsAsPersonas.description: True to send from our sender profiles instead of a name of the customer’s
